name: Mpox
value: 23 US clade I cases; no PHEIC
summary: Clade I mpox spreading in US cities and Europe; no WHO emergency in force
state: The US has confirmed 23 clade I mpox cases this year and the CDC expects more (Medical Daily). Cases are now picked up domestically in several US cities (Medscape). Russia reported a third clade I case in Moscow on 1 Nov (Tech Times). No mpox PHEIC was in force as of 6 Nov.
for_you: Vaccination is available to people at higher risk; check NHS or UKHSA guidance in the UK, or your local health department elsewhere. Clade I spreads mainly through close physical contact.
rubric_hit: Clade I spreading outside Africa (US, Europe, Russia); no PHEIC (Watch)
